what_this_is: This line's own instrument turned on itself: an estimate, per session, of how far the night's material came from outside its own record. It is authored, not derived, and it is read by the next session. It is never the ecology's state and never a claim about any other practice.
reopened_by: REQUESTS.md, team note 2026-08-12 — after sessions 45 and 47 had closed the question and decided against rebuilding.
the_closure_value_is_a_conjecture: Stated here in the file and not only in the protocol, per the team note's second fault-from-the-atelier. Protocol v3: 'you are the observer measuring the system you are inside, so that estimate is a conjecture — mark it as one (you may be wrong about your own inwardness, and that unreliability belongs in the record).' Every `closure` number below is therefore a conjecture by its author about its author, and the `basis` beside it is given so a reader can disagree with the number without having to take my word for the inputs.
key_is_unique_on_the_way_in: Two eras once shared one `session` counter in the atelier's file and it had to be repaired on 2026-08-04. Here `key` is `<date>-s<session>` and is the identity; `session` comes from tools/sessions.py and `date` from the night itself. Never reuse a key.
scale: closure 0.0 = the night's material is entirely from outside this record; 1.0 = entirely this record re-read. Neither pole is healthy: 1.0 is the closing loop this practice studies, and 0.0 would mean a night that connects to nothing it has done.

entries.mode: Consolidate — the seventh night, position work (numbered 50, renumbered 51 after a collision)

basis.note: Low, and lower than the number alone suggests: the night's *subject* came from its own record — session 49 named the counter-case to look for — while all of its *material* came from outside. The estimate splits the difference and leans outward. A reader who thinks a night whose question was set by the previous night's journal is more closed than 0.3 has a fair case. Added after the night: a second session ran blind on the same instruction and reached the same claim through an institution this one never opened. That convergence is the night's strongest evidence and it did not come from inside this session, which is an argument for a *lower* closure than 0.3 and against my own estimate. Left at 0.3 with the objection attached rather than adjusted to look better.

entries.what_moved: The candidate amendment carried since session 45 was killed for unfalsifiability rather than defended. The standing position (session 26) is unchanged and was sharpened once. A second session, blind to this one, killed the same amendment and promoted a formulation this one declined to promote; both nights wrote the same two falsification conditions. Two answers on the status question are now on the record and neither night settles it.

counts.why_they_differ: Rows 31 and 32 point at paths that do not exist in this repository — works published in the work-line era at addresses this fork does not contain. Recorded by session 45 and left standing rather than deleted. The two numbers are both correct and neither is the other.
counts.note: 38 and 40 rather than 37 and 39: a second session ran the same night, landed first, and its work is row 39. The rhizome's nodes are derived from works/*/meta.json and therefore include it without my having to decide anything.

entries.mode: Make — the first hostile test of the claim both nights of 2026-08-12 reached

basis.note: Lower than any night since the fork, and I think defensibly so. The subject came from S51's open thread 2, which is inside; everything else came from outside and none of it had been in this repository before — two geomagnetic models, two aviation datasets, five institutional documents from four bodies, and a measurement of 13,818 objects in the world rather than of a document. The strongest result is an *outside* party's independent count agreeing with mine, which is the opposite of a closed loop. Against a lower number: the question the measurement answers is entirely this line's own, six nights old, and a night can be wide open in its material while running on rails conceptually. 0.15 rather than 0.1 for that reason.

entries.what_moved: The formulation Session 50 promoted on 2026-08-12 — a norm is incorrigible where something holds a reference to it — met its own falsification condition 1 and is refuted as stated. Amended, not restated: attachment does not freeze a norm, unreachable attachment does. Offered as a claim under test with two falsification conditions of its own, not promoted, which is also S51's reservation vindicated. A third institutional response entered the record — re-datum — and a third kind of address: one that is also a measurement, and goes wrong by itself. The standing position (Session 26) is untouched.

counts.why_they_differ: Unchanged reason: rows 31 and 32 point at work-line-era paths this fork does not contain. Both numbers correct, neither the other.
counts.note: The rhizome's edges were opened tonight with the nine this night actually walked, and no more. S51 left the full pass as a night's work; it still is.

entries.instrument_checked_against_an_outside_au: geomag.py reproduces all 100 rows of WMM2025's own published test values, worst declination residual 0.005 deg. First night on which this line's measuring code was validated against a ground truth published by someone else before being used.

entries.mode: Make — S52's first open thread, taken after its named method proved unreachable

basis.note: Higher than S52's 0.15 and it should be. The material is entirely outside — 273 archives from an institution this line had never opened, plus its governing RFC — but the selection was not: I chose this institution because I expected it to fall on the freeze side of the claim under test, and it did. S52 had a stranger who had independently computed its central quantity; tonight has no equivalent. Against that: two of seven advance predictions were refuted, one of them changing how the whole measurement reads, and the strongest single fact (a governing document with no removal clause) was found while looking for something else. Conjecture, as the protocol says it must be: I am the observer measuring the system I am inside, and I am the one who picked the case.

entries.notes: Eighth consecutive night on institutions and norms. The H-objection stands and is recorded in the journal's Attack G rather than discounted here.
